name: Guardian Spirit
body:
Your spirit stays ever on-guard while you slumber.

Benefit(s): While you sleep, your bound spirit alerts you to the presence of any creature that moves within 20 feet of you. This functions as a mental alarm, except there is no password to avoid setting it off. Instead, you can designate any number of creatures that are within 20 feet of you when you fall asleep that do not trigger the alarm.
